newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel tracks crude, LS quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel tracks crude, LS quiet.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run trailed crude on Tuesday, showing gains on the back of crude's late strength, but no deals were seen.
"It's thinly offered, but also thinly requested," said one trader. Interest from the U.S. was still talked and one trader was rumoured to be taking a cargo transatlantic.

Pressure on high sulphur straight-run eased when crude strengthened. Dealers said cargoes were now at formula +$2.50/4 with M-100 at two means +$3/4. "There is not as much product as some people thought, but we could see some hitting the cracked market," said one. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8980
